section: Sabah A-A' (Dangerous Grounds -> Sulu Sea, ~833 km dog-leg)
source_of_truth: _geometry_raw.json (extracted verbatim from arif-fazil.com/earth/kinabalu-cross-section.html in-page data; public sources only)
non_negotiable_correction: Morley et al. (2023) is cited ONLY for the shallow mobile-shale / mud-canopy system (NSPW: mini-basins, feeder pipes, chambers, mud volcanoes). It is NOT a three-plate model, NOT a slab model, NOT an underthrusting model. No surface in the arif-fazil.com earth family attributes plates to Morley (verified by grep 2026-10-20).

A.scale: local body-scale (deep), practical question = maturation heat source
A.one_paper: no — working note (TS02, Fazil 2026), informed by regional potential-field literature
A.source_supports: regional context only (potential-field hints). Does NOT support intrusion geometry.
A.status_line: AUTHOR HYPOTHESIS — UNTESTED — NOT A PUBLISHED MODEL

B.scale: shallow (sedimentary column to upper crust, wedge interior)
B.synthesis: minor — wedge fill naming from regional framework
B.published_geometry: partial — 3D-seismic-based wedge architecture published, but NOT along A-A'
B.source_supports: shallow process only (mobile shale, mini-basins, feeder pipes, chambers, mud volcanoes). Does NOT support plate identity, crustal interpretation, or mantle geometry.
B.status_line: PUBLISHED (shallow process) — citation scope: mobile-shale system only

C.one_paper: no — classic synthesis (Hinz et al. 1989; Hazebroek & Tan 1993; Hutchison 2005)
C.published_geometry: NO along-section geometry published; drawn as schematic
C.source_supports: plate-scale convergence context + crustal architecture hypothesis. Contested by Vijayan et al. 2013 (no crustal suture / no relict oceanic crust beneath the trough; trough = foredeep, not trench).
C.status_line: CLASSIC SYNTHESIS — downgraded from assumption to one competing crustal hypothesis

D.one_paper: no — synthesis (Hall 2013; Cottam et al. 2010/2013; King et al. 2010; Cornwell et al. 2025)
D.published_geometry: partially — the 45-55 km W-dipping discontinuity is published imaging (Cornwell 2025); the drawn slab shape + asthenosphere are conceptual
D.source_supports: imaged deep discontinuity (constraint, not fitted), granite timing, gravity-vs-plate-scale budget. Does NOT publish an along-line slab geometry.
